topbar.title: Share page
notice.public: This page is public: anyone with the link can open it without signing in. Do not share sensitive content.
noDoc: Open a document first, or right-click one in the document tree.
progress.long: Many images: this may take a while
progress.veryLong: Still working; you can cancel anytime
result.title: Share page ready
result.partial: Page created, but {0} images could not be written. Visitors will see placeholders; the link still works.
error.title: Generation failed
error.empty: This document has no exportable content.
error.notFound: Document not found; it may have been moved or deleted.
error.disk: Failed to write data/public. Check the directory permissions.
error.exportUnknown: Export failed: the kernel returned an error. The document may have been moved or deleted.
error.reachability: Public link unreachable. Make sure the reverse proxy forwards /public/ to SiYuan.
error.assets: Shared assets could not be written; the page falls back to plain text without highlighting or math.
confirm.overwriteBody: {0} was generated {1}. Overwriting will show the new content to everyone with the link.
confirm.newVersion: Save as new version (create {0}, keep the old link)
confirm.deleteBody: The page disappears from the public web immediately and existing links return 404. This cannot be undone.
confirm.renameBody: The old link stops working immediately. Make sure you have notified anyone using it.
confirm.cleanBody: Delete directories under data/public that are not tracked by this plugin. Manually placed files will be deleted too.
settings.title: Light Share settings
settings.linkHint: Links look like {0}/<slug>/. The prefix must match your reverse proxy; changes do not migrate existing pages.
settings.slugHint: Slugs may contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. Chinese titles are transliterated; you can also set one manually.
settings.mergeHint: When enabled, all child documents are appended to the page.
settings.imageModeHint: Folder: smaller and cacheable. Inline: single file, but much larger.
settings.singleFile: Single-file mode (inline math and highlight scripts)
settings.singleFileHint: Inlines math and highlight assets into the HTML for easy forwarding; the page grows significantly.
manage.title: Share Pages Console
guide.title: Welcome to Light Share
guide.intro: Turn a SiYuan document into a public web page that anyone can open without signing in.
guide.testBody: A temporary page will be created and checked. It is deleted after the test.
guide.okBody: Test page opened successfully: {0}　It has been deleted.
guide.nextSteps:
Now share your first document:
1. Right-click any document in the tree
2. Choose “Share page”
3. The link is copied automatically
guide.warn: Published pages are publicly accessible without login. Do not share sensitive content. Files live in data/public.
guide.fail404: The domain responds but /public/ was not found. Configure the reverse proxy to forward /public/ to SiYuan.
guide.failTimeout: Cannot reach {0}. Check the domain and server status.
guide.fail403: Access to /public/ was denied. Check your reverse proxy access rules.
slug.invalidChars: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only
slug.space: Spaces are not allowed; use hyphens
log.title: Detailed log
protect.title: Export with protection
protect.intro: Set access restrictions for this document. After regeneration, the link follows these rules.
protect.passwordHint: Leave empty for no password. Visitors must enter the correct code to read the content.
protect.passwordInvalid: The code must be exactly 4 digits.
protect.disclaimer: Note: this is client-side soft validation. It only stops casual visitors; anyone with the page source can bypass it. Do not use it for sensitive content.
settings.firstHint: First time here? Confirm your domain and path prefix, then publish a document. This window will not open automatically; you can revisit it any time in plugin settings.
settings.guideEntryBody: Verify the public link works and finish the first-time setup.
settings.protectHint: Default password for new pages; change per page in the share panel, and re-publishing keeps the existing password. Shown as •••• when unchanged.
share.title: Share this document
share.qrHint: Scan with your phone camera or WeChat to open on mobile; click the QR code to enlarge.
share.passwordKeepHint: Keep •••• to retain the current code; leave empty for no code; enter 4 digits to set a new one.
share.applied: Applied: link unchanged; external access takes effect after sync to server.
settings.linkFormatHint: Build the share URL from {domain}, {prefix} and {slug}, e.g. {domain}/{prefix}/{slug}/. Must contain {slug}; a trailing slash is added automatically.
settings.linkFormatInvalid: The URL format must contain the {slug} placeholder.
settings.footerHint: Credit appears at the end of the footer meta line; note appears on the second line. Leave empty to hide.
manage.footerHint: Saves and applies to all published pages (paused pages pick it up on resume); per-page defaults can also be edited in plugin settings.
manage.applyFooter: Save and apply to all pages
manage.resumeFail: Source document not found; cannot resume.
settings.remotePublish: Write directly to the remote SiYuan when publishing
settings.remoteHint: Optional. When enabled, the page is also written to the remote SiYuan instance, so the public URL updates immediately without waiting for workspace sync. Copy the token from the remote SiYuan: Settings → About → API token.
settings.remoteNeedToken: Fill in the remote base URL and API Token before enabling remote publish.
share.remoteOk: The public page is up to date.
share.remoteFail: The public page is not updated yet: {0} (the page was written locally and will update after S3 sync).
progress.cancelledNote: The new page was not written; the previous version stays as is. Publish again to finish.
footer.applyBody: Footer saved. Apply it to the {0} published page(s)?
footer.applyHint: Each page is regenerated silently; slug and password stay unchanged. This may take a while.
remote.noBase: Remote base URL is not configured
remote.stale: The public page is still an old version
remote.verifyFail: Cannot verify the public page version
error.timeout: Processing timed out. The page may already be written; refresh or check the public version in the manager.
